text: Completed: shared CsvNumber exact-IEEE-bit decimal renderer in ContrastCsv (and delegated temporal export) and TemplateFitCsv. Preserves signed zero and exact parsed values; documented canonical trailing-zero/exponent spelling. Pinned 19 decimal boundary literals plus independent Python-decimal SHA-256 over 16376 exponent/sign/mantissa cases agree on JVM and Scala.js; every swept value round-trips bit-for-bit. Study sigma and scalar cells now have exact-text assertions; complete training CSV is pinned without rewriting historical R fixtures. InspectionSourceSuite checks exact parsed bits and explicit missing cells. Original JVM sigma regression reproduced before implementation; first-pass Scala.js BigDecimal(Double) defect exposed and avoided. Final ioJVM/test, ioJS/test, checkBoundaries, headerCheckAll, scalafmtCheckAll, scalafmtSbtCheck and githubWorkflowCheck all passed (log /private/tmp/eyes4s-csv-verify-final.log). Scoped code and tracker edits remain uncommitted; unrelated .claude preserved.
